notes.title: Strategic Focus
notes.content:
# Strategic Focus - May 2026

Build the system. Run the play.

## Luxe Property Solutions
- Seller conversations are the needle mover.
- Track MCTP on every lead.
- Push offers daily.

## Get Right Fitness
- Keep the offer simple.
- Sell accountability and structure.
- Use proof-of-work content.

## AI Systems
- Build tools that save time this week, not someday.

warRoomCommands.output: Use a three-touch follow-up: direct SMS, softer value text, then a clear next-step close. Keep the message calm, specific, and anchored to motivation, condition, timeline, and price.
